title: EXE/window launch readiness, minimize/restore, close and reopen
expected: Usable window opens cleanly without hidden modals; splash/startup completes cleanly.

title: Worksheet/output splitter extremes and view-mode switching
expected: Splitter resizes cleanly to both extremes (<80px top and expanded top), restoring usable space in split/data/output modes.

title: Top-level menus open cleanly, toolbar icons readable with tooltips and parity triggers
expected: Every top-level menu populates actions; toolbar actions have non-empty icons/tooltips and match menu behavior.

title: Navigator scroll/collapse, 50 outputs, tab close/reopen fidelity
expected: Active title, worksheet association, and tab selection agree across 20 sheets / 50 outputs; closing one tab preserves others and allows reopen.

title: Multi-monitor placement and off-screen dialog recovery after monitor removal
expected: Dialog remains visible on active screen at valid scale; hardware dual-monitor hot-unplug marked BLOCKED when <2 monitors present.

title: Exclusive column-name vs data-cell selection across 20 alternations and Shift-ranges
expected: Clicking/editing C2 name vs row 4 data cell never shows simultaneous selection outlines; Shift-click range stays bounded to data table.

title: Keyboard cell entry & navigation (Tab, Enter, Shift+Tab/Enter, F2, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End/Enter)
expected: Values commit once to exact target cells with expected direction movement and F2 inline edit support.

title: Insert/rename/move/duplicate/clear/delete column + Undo/Redo
expected: Headers, names, types, and values move together and undo/redo restores exact worksheet state.

title: Rectangular copy/paste, cut/paste across sheets, overwrite cancel safety
expected: Mixed numeric/text/date rectangles align cleanly on paste without extra header rows; cancelled operations leave target untouched.

title: Worksheet rename/add/duplicate/delete/close and cancellation
expected: Cancelled delete preserves worksheet; deleting copy and closing resets active worksheet cleanly.

title: Freeze/unfreeze, hide/unhide, column resize, boundary scroll and edit on F4
expected: Column headers, names, and frozen regions remain aligned across vertical/horizontal boundaries; edited cell commits cleanly.

title: Worksheet/output split synchronization, shared edit, active sheet change, close split
expected: Workspace split view shows synchronized results; worksheet edits mark stale output accurately without wrong-sheet mutation.

title: Sort, filter, conditional formatting rule updates, undo, hide/unhide on F2
expected: Row relationships stay intact across sort/filter, conditional highlights update cleanly after edits, and undo reverts state.

title: Graph > Scatterplot > Simple selection via double-click, Select button, and keyboard
expected: List displays `C#  Name` entries; active Y/X slot receives transferred columns and submits valid scatterplot.

title: Variable filter/search, duplicate/long/blank names, C-range notation on 250-column F4-wide
expected: Unambiguous variable identities across 250 columns; filter narrows without substituting wrong columns.

title: Child sub-dialog (Scale/Labels) Cancel, parent Cancel, reopen, Reset/F3
expected: Child/parent Cancel discards uncommitted options cleanly; F3/Reset clears selections to defaults.

title: Validation errors on empty variables, invalid limits, text-as-numeric, identical axes, constant response
expected: Clear error prompt displayed at dialog without traceback, silent success, or hung modal; valid resubmit succeeds.

title: Keyboard-only navigation across Histogram, Regression, ANOVA, Capability, ARIMA, and DOE dialogs
expected: Controls open cleanly and respond to Tab/Escape without focus traps or accidental submission.

title: Create Histogram, Scatterplot, and Boxplot via dialog workflows
expected: Graph tab activates immediately with correct title, axes, variable names, and worksheet badge.

title: Histogram explicit bin edge/bar hover tooltips & hide/reset after resize
expected: Hovering histogram bar pixel coordinates produces accurate bin interval/count tooltip and clears outside bars.

title: Scatter hover & brushing with missing values preserves original worksheet row indices
expected: Hovering/brushing after missing rows (rows 3, 9, 12, 17) reports original row numbers and exact coordinates.

title: Edit Graph right-side Options pane (title, subtitle, footnote, axis labels, close/reopen)
expected: Graph Options pane opens on right side, updates active chart live, persists across reopen, and renders no debug chrome.

title: Edit axis range, log scale, reference lines, series styles, and invalid limits recovery
expected: Valid scale/ref changes update plotted chart; invalid limits (min >= max) raise clear validation error cleanly.

title: 3D Scatterplot & 3D Surface drag rotation, zoom, and Reset 3D View Defaults
expected: View azimuth/elevation/zoom update during drag/orbit and Reset 3D View Defaults restores DEFAULT_VIEW.

title: Duplicate graph independent edit state, close original, reopen duplicate, save/reopen project
expected: Duplicated graph retains independent title/presentation after original is closed and project is reloaded.

title: Matrix, Marginal, Contour, Probability, Interval, Heatmap, Time Series, Bar, and Pie plots
expected: Every graph family renders non-blank readable panels and legends with zero errors.

title: Crosshair mode, text annotation insert/duplicate, resize, and brushed-row navigation
expected: Crosshair toggle reflects checked state, annotations render/duplicate cleanly, and brushing updates status strip.

title: 24-category legend / extreme values rendering across narrow resize, zoom, light & dark modes
expected: Plot area and labels remain readable across compact/dark/zoomed renders without crashing or clipping essential ticks.

title: Open disposable MPX copies (quiz1-recovered F5 & lecture F6) and navigate sheets/outputs
expected: All worksheets and native outputs open cleanly with accurate grouping and visible tables/graphs.

title: Open imported contour, surface, factorial, and optimizer outputs; inspect Edit Graph
expected: Saved graphs display accurately first; supported presentation edits work cleanly and imported status is clear.

title: Edit cell/name/title, add analysis, Save Copy MPX, close and reopen; original hash unchanged
expected: All original sheets and native outputs survive alongside edits and new analyses; original F6 SHA-256 unchanged.

title: Switch worksheets across similar titles; refit native model and test cancel path
expected: Refit binds correct worksheet/columns without overwriting unrelated original native entry; cancel leaves state clean.

title: Malformed MPX and missing path error recovery preserves existing valid project
expected: Clear error message without discarding active valid project; subsequent F1 open succeeds.

title: Response Surface Available Designs matrix valid vs blank cell selection
expected: Clicking valid catalog cell selects matching factor/run configuration; blank cells do not select invalid designs.

title: 2-factor CCD blocking, custom center points, alpha (default/face/custom), and replicates
expected: Dependent controls enable/disable cleanly and generated worksheet run count matches displayed design summary.

title: Plackett-Burman 20, mixed 3x2 factorial, and 8-factor 16-run fractional designs
expected: Expected run counts, factor names/levels, and design summaries match created worksheets.

title: Repeated DOE family/factor switches and cancel leak check
expected: No stale run counts or factor settings leak across family switches; cancelling dialog creates no worksheet.

title: Split-plot factorial creation and two-stratum analysis via UI dialogs
expected: Hard-to-change/whole-plot structure is visible in design worksheet and analyzed cleanly via dialog.

title: Response Surface analysis -> Contour/Surface/Factorial plots -> Response Optimizer chain
expected: Fitted response surface model carries cleanly into plots and optimizer without fabricated output.

title: DOCX and PPTX export structure, non-empty slides/paragraphs, embedded chart PNGs
expected: Valid .docx and .pptx archives created containing title/table text and embedded chart images (external viewer marked BLOCKED if absent).

title: PNG, SVG, and PDF chart exports in light/dark modes
expected: All exported PNG/SVG/PDF files are non-empty, structurally valid, and contain readable rendered graphics.

title: Export multi-sheet F6 workbook to XLSX and verify sheet names, counts, and typed cell values
expected: Output .xlsx preserves all worksheet tabs, column headers, numeric/text values accurately.

title: ReportPad multi-output append, edit, HTML/TXT save, and PrintJob snapshot verification
expected: Appended outputs appear in explicit order, save cleanly to HTML/TXT, and generate valid PrintJob.

title: R script export copy/save and cancellation without unintended external execution
expected: Generated R/tidyverse script reflects selected variables cleanly and saves/copies without side effects.

title: Isolated settings persistence (zoom, font, entry direction) across window restart
expected: Changed preferences persist into new ModernWindow in isolated INI while production settings remain untouched.

title: Dirty-state close prompts (Cancel, Save, Discard) on New/Open/Close
expected: Cancel preserves dirty project; Save writes file cleanly; Discard clears dirty state cleanly.

title: Isolated autosave snapshot write, simulated crash relaunch recovery UI, and decline path
expected: Autosave writes valid JSON to filesystem path, recovers exact worksheet on relaunch, and honors decline without touching originals.

title: Ctrl+L command pane valid/invalid commands, history cycling, and focus recovery
expected: Valid commands run and append output; invalid commands report clear session/status errors without losing editor focus.

title: Exhaustive menu, submenu, and toolbar inventory across empty & populated states
expected: Every menu item and toolbar button classified cleanly in JSON with enabled/checkable state and tooltip coverage.

title: Large 100k x 20 and 250-column F4-wide 30x scrollbar stress and boundary edits
expected: Grid stays responsive (<200ms p95 selection), headers align at boundaries, edits commit cleanly.

title: Repetition soak: 100 output switches, 30 graph creates/closes, 30 modal cancels, 20 sheet switches
expected: Zero orphan dialogs, zero unhandled exceptions, bounded elapsed timings and clean window state.

title: Compute progress/double-submit guard and responsiveness during large analysis
expected: Background/large compute finishes cleanly with zero duplicate corruption or event-loop deadlock.

title: Multi-resolution (1920x1080, 1366x768, 1024x700), light/dark, and keyboard accessibility check
expected: Critical controls remain reachable with zero clipped buttons across tested window sizes and themes.

title: Packaged StatCraft.exe verification (version, SHA-256, smoke verify, live launch & clean termination)
expected: Packaged dist/StatCraft.exe matches source version, passes --smoke-verify, and stays alive after launch.
